subject: Intro: Dedicated capacity demo request — throughput & latency triage
messages:
From: Alexandra Ortiz <alex.ortiz@flowrite.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo inquiry — throughput/latency goals

Hi Evelyn,

We just completed a self-serve trial and are interested in a Dedicated capacity walkthrough focused on throughput and latency. High level:
- Workload: API inference for customer-facing completion service
- Typical concurrency: ~30–40 concurrent requests during peak
- Avg response size: ~450–600 tokens (we pad occasionally)
- Target: p95 latency < 150ms for 512-token outputs; steady-state throughput ~200 reqs/min (bursts to 1k/min)
- Monthly volume (estimate): ~25–40M tokens

Can you set up a demo that walks through Dedicated sizing, autoscale behavior, KV/prefix caching, and the latency metrics we can realistically achieve on a 70B-style open model? We’d also like to confirm isolation and encryption options.

Attaching a sample traffic export. Please loop in the right person on infra. Our network/security lead is Samir (cc’d).

Thanks — Alexandra
Alexandra Ortiz
Head of ML Platforms, Flowrite Labs
alex.ortiz@flowrite.io
Attachment: sample_traffic.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Ortiz <alex.ortiz@flowrite.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo inquiry — throughput/latency goals

Hi Alexandra — great to meet you, and thanks for the detail.

Happy to get a Dedicated-focused walkthrough scheduled. Quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session:
- Which model family are you evaluating (eg. Llama 2 / MetaX / custom)?
- Are the bursts predictable (time-of-day) or event-driven?
- Any compliance requirements (SOC2/PII handling/KMS) we should prep for?

Proposed 45–60 minute slots (all CEST-friendly):
- Tue Jul 25, 10:00–11:00 CEST
- Wed Jul 26, 14:00–15:00 CEST
- Thu Jul 27, 08:30–09:30 CEST

I’ve attached a short pre-demo checklist that helps us validate the traffic profile and confirm the demo script. If none of those times work, tell me some windows and we’ll move things around.

Ben Carter
Sales Development Representative, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0130
Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (PDF, 38KB)
From: Alexandra Ortiz <alex.ortiz@flowrite.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo inquiry — throughput/latency goals

Thanks Ben — Wed Jul 26 at 14:00 CEST works for us. A few more details so you can scope the session:
- Model: Llama-70B distilled -> we’ll likely run a quantized 4-bit variant in production
- Typical concurrent warm requests: 36
- Avg sequence length: 512 tokens; peaks up to 1k tokens for long-form tasks
- p95 target: 150ms for 512 tokens; anything under 250ms acceptable during short bursts
- Encryption: in transit required; at-rest via KMS preferred but not mandatory for demo

Please include a quick section on: warm-cache behavior (KV/prefix caching), autoscale and burst handling, and how fallbacks to smaller variants affect latency/cost.

Also, will the demo show end-to-end metrics (p50/p95/p99) and token-level cost estimates? If so, great.

Looping Samir for any network-specific constraints. We’ll also share a small synthetic traffic file (already attached in first email).

See you Wed.

—Alexandra
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Ortiz <alex.ortiz@flowrite.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Dedicated walkthrough (Wed Jul 26, 14:00 CEST) — agenda & links

Alexandra — thanks, confirmed for Wed Jul 26, 14:00–15:00 CEST. Calendar invite sent (Google Meet).

Agenda (45–60m):
1) Quick intro & goals (5m)
2) Traffic profile & sizing recommendations (10m)
3) Live Dedicated demo: baseline latency, autoscale, and burst handling (20m)
4) Caching + KV/prefix demo and warm-start observations (10m)
5) Q&A + next steps (10m)

Meeting link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-meet-link
HubSpot record: 32094

Attachments included for the session: SLA_Summary.pdf (high level SLA + Dedicated SLAs), pre-demo-checklist.pdf (you should have this already).

Internal note (Ben/Laura): please make sure demo includes:
- A short run showing p95 with and without prefix caching (use synthetic file Alexandra provided)
- Autoscale behavior under 60s burst; show queueing/backpressure and fallback to smaller model variant
- Token-cost estimate overlay in Console so customer sees economics tradeoffs

If anything changes on your side, reply here and we’ll rebook. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
